text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука returns victorious from
her debut
race, with the scenery from
the lead burned into
her memory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But it's not enough for her—she yearns
to see
even more breathtaking scenery
in other races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
